title: Encode → Decode Round Trip
hints: Enums with associated values get synthesised `Codable`.
Encode the parsed events with `.sortedKeys`, decode them back, and compare with `==`.
jsBridge: Swift synthesises `Codable` even for enums with associated values, producing JSON like `{"purchase":{"item":"pen","cents":150}}`. A TS discriminated union needs a hand-written serialiser or a library.
